notes.title: Version 0.3.0 Out Now.
notes.content:
Hi Everyone,

It has been mid November (2024) last year when we last posted an update and early September since an update came out. I know it has been a long time. 


I have decided to release  0.3.0 now with what I have so far otherwise you will not see this update this year. I got to say that this the biggest update I have done ever for Dairy Farm Simulator. Most of this update has been doing art, making / changing maps, new buildings & objects which took a lot of my limited spare time I have.


What can you expect in this release.
[list]
[*] Milk Bottle Collection Re-Introduced.
[*] Collectable VHS Tapes.
[*] A lot of Map Changes.
[*] New Objects.
[*] New Buildings.
[*] New Maps.
[*] First In Game Cutscene (More Coming).
[*] Many other minor things.
[/list]

What can you expect in future releases coming very soon (Hopefully this year)
[list]
[*] Day Night Cycles Re-Introduced.
[*] Collectables.
[*] Finally Be Able To Milk Cows (Yay!)
[*] NPC's
[*] New Objects.
[*] New Buildings.
[*] New Maps.
[*] Dozens More In Game Cutscenes.
[*] Unlockables.
[*] Shops
[*] Events & Fairs
[*] Dozens Of New Features & Twists.
[/list]

I know this might not be much for you, but it is the step in the right direction.

I look forward to your feedback and I will see you in the next update hopefully coming soon.

Kind Regards,
Patrick

notes.title: Version 0.2.3 Out Now!
notes.content:
Hi everyone,

Version 0.2.3 is out now. 

Why did it takes so long, well we have decided to move from Unity to Godot game engine so we had to port (rebuild) everything over. Their is still a few things we have left to put back in which is the milk bottle collection and day/night cycle. We have add a lot of new things as well for this release. 
Why did we switch over to Godot is that Unity is a bit heavy weighted in which it was slowing me down to develop this kind of game. I have found that port things over and developing stuff is a lot easier than unity and a lot faster too. So you should see more frequent updates in the future, but please be aware I am not working on this like a full-time job so please be patient. 
Please note that save games from 0.2.2 will not work in this version, sorry. Godot doesn't support XML.

Check the forum for all the goodies of the changelog.

Regards,
Patrick

notes.title: Version 0.2.0 Out Now!
notes.content:
Hi Everyone,

Happy New year and I hope everyone is safe & well.

It has been a very long time since I done any work on the game or put out an update. I have been taking this time to reflect on the vision I had when I switched the development from web based to this format. 

A lot of people close to me said a lot of things and the one thing that stand out on what they said is :[i] "Your game is going to get boring after a while and people will lose interest in the game doing the same repetitive things like clicking & milking. You need to the make the game more alive, more interactive and fun. Not a daunting task clicking buttons to milk cows day in and day out."[/i]

Taking on that feedback, that what I have been trying to do this since October 2023 with version: 0.2.0, to rebuild the game from scratch and take it in a different direction. The game focus is not to be a 2D clicker game anymore, but a game that you move around in a very huge world, build a dairy farm, walk in paddocks, build a big town,  clean up the environment by collecting milk bottles, go on adventures, make friends, find love and have children and much more.

Please note that 0.2.0 is very small stepping stone and that I have a lot of work ahead for me in 2024 to flesh out the game further so please be patient. But your feedback in the forum will also be useful with development for ideas and bug reports. You will find also that I will be posting more builds in the BETA channel before it goes to the main branch so keep an eye out for that if you want the latest builds you want to test.


Also see if you can find and collect all 1,000 milk bottles in the game.


So enjoy and until next time.


if you haven't already got Dairy Farm Simulator on Early Access yet, you can buy it right now here on Steam. You can get it now or wait for the seasonal / custom discounts to come out.


Kind Regards,
Patrick
